items.source: MetaProvider - Interface implemented to supply _meta field data for tool, prompt, and resource declarations. Referenced via the metaProvider attribute of @McpTool, @McpPrompt, and @McpResource.
items.translation: MetaProvider - 用于为工具、提示词和资源声明提供 _meta 字段数据的接口。通过 @McpTool、@McpPrompt 和 @McpResource 的 metaProvider 属性引用。

items.source: @McpProgressToken - Marks a method parameter to receive the progress token from the request. This parameter is automatically injected and excluded from the generated JSON schema. Note: When using McpSyncRequestContext or McpAsyncRequestContext, the progress token can be accessed via ctx.request().progressToken() instead of using this annotation.
items.translation: @McpProgressToken - 标记方法参数以接收来自请求的进度令牌。该参数会自动注入，并从生成的 JSON Schema 中排除。注意：在使用 McpSyncRequestContext 或 McpAsyncRequestContext 时，可以通过 ctx.request().progressToken() 访问进度令牌，而无需使用此注解。

items.source: McpMeta - Special parameter type that provides access to metadata from MCP requests, notifications, and results. This parameter is automatically injected and excluded from parameter count limits and JSON schema generation. Note: When using McpSyncRequestContext or McpAsyncRequestContext, metadata can be obtained via ctx.requestMeta() instead.
items.translation: McpMeta - 一种特殊的参数类型，用于访问来自 MCP 请求、通知和结果的元数据。该参数会自动注入，不计入参数数量限制，也不会参与 JSON Schema 生成。注意：当使用 McpSyncRequestContext 或 McpAsyncRequestContext 时，可通过 ctx.requestMeta() 获取元数据。

items.source: McpAsyncRequestContext - Special parameter type for asynchronous operations that provides the same unified interface as McpSyncRequestContext but with reactive (Mono-based) return types. This parameter is automatically injected and excluded from JSON schema generation. Supported in Complete, Prompt, Resource, and Tool methods.
items.translation: McpAsyncRequestContext - 一种用于异步操作的专用参数类型，它提供与 McpSyncRequestContext 相同的统一接口，但采用基于 reactive（Mono）的返回类型。该参数会自动注入，并排除在 JSON schema 生成之外。支持 Complete、Prompt、Resource 和 Tool 方法。

items.source: McpSyncRequestContext - Special parameter type for synchronous operations that provides a unified interface for accessing MCP request context, including the original request, server exchange (for stateful operations), transport context (for stateless operations), and convenient methods for logging, progress, sampling, elicitation, and roots access. This parameter is automatically injected and excluded from JSON schema generation. Supported in Complete, Prompt, Resource, and Tool methods.
items.translation: McpSyncRequestContext - 用于同步操作的专用参数类型，提供访问 MCP 请求上下文的统一接口，包括原始请求、服务器交换（针对有状态操作）、传输上下文（针对无状态操作），以及便捷的日志记录、进度跟踪、采样、引导和根目录访问方法。该参数会自动注入并排除在 JSON Schema 生成之外。支持 Complete、Prompt、Resource 和 Tool 方法。

items.source: The Spring AI MCP Annotations module provides annotation-based method handling for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients in Java. It simplifies the creation and registration of MCP server methods and client handlers through a clean, declarative approach using Java annotations.
items.translation: Spring AI MCP 注解模块为 Java 中的 模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器和客户端提供基于注解的方法处理。它通过一种简洁的声明式方法，利用 Java 注解简化了 MCP 服务器方法和客户端处理器的创建与注册过程。

items.source: This library builds on top of the MCP Java SDK to provide a higher-level, annotation-based programming model for implementing MCP servers and clients.
items.translation: 该库基于MCP Java SDK构建，为实施 MCP 服务器和客户端提供了更高级的基于注解的编程模型。

items.source: @McpTool - Implements MCP tools with automatic JSON schema generation
items.translation: @McpTool - 实现带有自动 JSON Schema 生成的 MCP 工具

items.source: @McpResource - Provides access to resources via URI templates
items.translation: @McpResource - 通过 URI 模板提供对资源的访问

items.source: @McpPrompt - Generates prompt messages
items.translation: @McpPrompt - 生成提示消息

items.source: @McpComplete - Provides auto-completion functionality
items.translation: @McpComplete - 提供自动补全功能

items.source: @McpLogging - Handles logging message notifications
items.translation: @McpLogging - 处理日志消息通知

items.source: @McpSampling - Handles sampling requests
items.translation: @McpSampling - 处理采样请求

items.source: @McpElicitation - Handles elicitation requests for gathering additional information
items.translation: @McpElicitation - 处理用于收集额外信息的请求

items.source: @McpProgress - Handles progress notifications during long-running operations
items.translation: @McpProgress - 处理长时间运行操作期间的进度通知

items.source: @McpToolListChanged - Handles tool list change notifications
items.translation: @McpToolListChanged - 处理工具列表变更通知

items.source: @McpResourceListChanged - Handles resource list change notifications
items.translation: @McpResourceListChanged - 处理资源列表变更通知

items.source: @McpPromptListChanged - Handles prompt list change notifications
items.translation: @McpPromptListChanged - 处理提示列表变更通知

items.source: McpTransportContext - Special parameter type for stateless operations that provides lightweight access to transport-level context without full server exchange functionality. This parameter is automatically injected and excluded from JSON schema generation
items.translation: McpTransportContext - 一种用于无状态操作的专用参数类型，提供轻量级的传输级上下文访问，而无需完整的服务器交换功能。该参数会自动注入，并排除在 JSON Schema 生成之外。
